svg.title: Standard oddball: Neuropixels, mesoscope dff, SLAP2 glutamate
svg.desc: Three native-size modality columns, not matched cells or experiments. A/B/C: single-session examples; D/E/F: single-session populations. G/H/I: distinct Neuropixels, mesoscope and verified-subset SLAP2 glutamate cohorts. I shows pooled proportions plus two mouse/session points, no CI. SLAP2 channels share 119 glutamate-SNR-selected sources, not calcium-specific quality selection. Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials; signals share the trial set within each DMD. No cross-modality statistical test. neuropixels: One 54 mm-wide modality column, headed by the Neuropixels icon reused from Figure 3 and its modality label, replacing the condition legend. A: responsive VISp5 unit 964 and Q2-nonsignificant VISp4 unit 993; context trial rasters with matching raw context/control mean-rate traces directly below on identical raw-Hz y-limits. Titles are Responsive and Unresponsive; the latter means Q2-nonsignificant, not visually inactive. There are 34 clean context and 68 control trials. Context is green; control is a grey line at 50 percent opacity. D: context baseline-subtracted Hz heatmap for all 203 eligible visual SUA, retaining the frozen context-only Rastermap row order. Below, context/control mean traces share one baseline-subtracted Hz axis with plus/minus across-neuron SEM. Solid curves equally weight 37 pooled visual units, selected by 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1. Heatmap rows have no responsiveness filter. Dotted curves equally weight 92 cortical Q2-nonsignificant units: visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p and MI, p >=0.05; no example-only MI or firing-rate threshold; inherited QC-passing SUA firingRateHz >1. The two populations differ in anatomical scope but share the same Hz scale. SEM is sample SD (ddof=1) of per-unit SDFs divided by sqrt(neuron count), not trial or across-mouse uncertainty; response-selected descriptive curves. All SDFs use 5 ms bins, a normalized causal 25 ms exponential kernel with 250 ms support, and hidden pre-event padding. Tan/grey indicate preceding presentation/deviant windows. Each condition's baseline mean pools full 20 ms bins from its clean trials' preceding grey intervals. No baseline-SD division or zero-SD masking is used. The heatmap, population means and SEM use baseline-subtracted Hz. No colorbar is shown; heatmap colors span -44 to 44 spikes/s, with blue negative and red positive. A/D: one session, ecephys_830794_2026-01-27_11-25-31, from mouse 830794; their means do not pool across sessions. G: 90-degree either-sign responsiveness in LGd, VISp, VISl, VISa, pooled frontal, pooled hippocampal (HIP), SSp and pooled STR areas, in that order, across 13 QC-pass standard sessions from 13 mice. Each region has Q1, Q2 and Both bars, with blue, orange and green encoding respectively. Passing means p <0.05 and absolute MI >0.1, including suppression. Both is the intersection, including opposite-sign responses. All three bars use the same joint-testable eligible neuron denominator; numerators are restricted to that shared set. Bars pool neuron counts; error bars show 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap intervals (10000 resamples) on all three bars, on a 0-100 percent axis. Each resample draws contributing mice with replacement within the region and recomputes summed responsive / summed testable counts, rather than averaging mouse percentages or resampling individual neurons. The same mouse draws are used for all three screens. Each session/group must have at least 20 QC-passing SUA, counted before firing-rate or response-test filtering and excluding curated probes. STR pools LSr, LSc, STR, CP and SH. Frontal, hippocampal and striatal constituent areas are pooled before this cutoff; excluded sessions contribute to neither bars nor bootstrap intervals. The existing >1 Hz and finite-test response denominator is unchanged. This either-sign cohort differs from D's positive-only solid curves. Undefined tests are not unresponsive. ProbeC is excluded for saturation in mouse 820454. Sample sizes and coverage are published in the linked cohort tables. Intervals are pointwise, conditional on the fixed inclusion rules, and exploratory with 5-13 mice per group; they are not simultaneous intervals or tests between bars. The first example passes positive Q1 AND Q2; the comparison has Q2 p >=0.05, abs(Q2 MI) <0.25 and session FR >3 Hz, with no Q1 restriction; this unit has significant negative Q1 modulation. Nonsignificance is not proof of no effect or absent visual responsiveness. mesoscope: Mesoscope dff comparison. B/E: mouse 832700, January 30 2026, one session. 1475 High/Intermediate-SNR soma-labelled ROIs in VISp/VISl. 34 clean 90-degree context and 68 matched control trials. B: identical positive-joint and Q2-nonsignificant example ROIs across both versions, VISl_6:64, VISp_1:52; context trial heatmaps and context (green)/control (grey, 50% opacity) means with across-trial SEM. The responsive example additionally requires a peak trial-averaged baseline-subtracted context dF/F >0.5 during [0,0.5) s in native stored units. Its peak is 0.915552. This amplitude gate applies only to panel B, not population classifications. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not absence of visual responsiveness. E: context population heatmap in the same frozen context-dF/F Rastermap order for both signals. Population means and across-neuron SEM: solid positive Q1/Q2 responders (225 ROIs), dotted Q2-nonsignificant (1002 ROIs), classified separately per signal. All displayed values subtract each trial's native preceding-grey baseline. Statistical windows use native-frame means, not display interpolation: paired Q1 oddball versus preceding standard over equal 500-ms windows; Q2 Mann-Whitney on context/control response minus full preceding-grey baseline. Exploratory p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1; solid means additionally require both MI>0.1. Signed MIs are not clipped. No firing-rate eligibility gate, spike conversion, or Neuropixels smoothing kernel. Linear alignment at approximately 9.48 Hz is display-only. Tan/grey shading shows actual preceding-standard/oddball presentation windows (median trial-aligned bounds, approximately 367 ms), not the 500-ms statistical windows. X-limits remain -0.75 to +0.75 s. Units: ΔF/F change (%); native stored values without additional scaling. Heatmaps blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar; rounded 99th absolute percentile limits: B ±2, E ±0.4; larger values saturate. These response-selected curves are descriptive; SEM is not across mice. H: 90-degree cohort across 20 sessions in 10 mice. Pool planes within session/area; include groups with at least 20 eligible somatic High/Intermediate-SNR ROIs, before checking testability. Q1/Q2/Both bars include either MI sign and use this signal's own eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable denominator; n labels are ROI/session observations, not unique longitudinal neurons. Heights are pooled counts, not means of session/mouse percentages. Uncapped lines show exact 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap bounds (10,000 resamples, seed 0): resample whole mice carrying every retained session, then recompute pooled ratios. H has no amplitude gate. VISp: 15719 jointly testable / 15719 eligible ROI/session observations, 20 contributing sessions, 10 mice; Q1 5517, Q2 4066, Both 2633. VISl: 12521 jointly testable / 12521 eligible ROI/session observations, 20 contributing sessions, 10 mice; Q1 4326, Q2 2946, Both 1993. slap2: SLAP2 glutamate: stored green iGluSnFR4f dFF series, native a.u., without additional scaling. C/F: mouse 828408, November 18 2025, one standard-oddball session. 134 original sources; 119 eligible (DMD1 79, DMD2 40), pooled across DMDs. Both signals use the identical frozen archive-wide glutamate High/Intermediate-SNR selection, not calcium-specific SNR. Fifteen no-baseline-noise sources excluded. Protocol-clean 90-degree trials: 30 context/68 control. Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials: DMD1 28 context/59 control; DMD2 28 context/38 control. Acquisition segments split at gaps >3 median native frame intervals; each statistical window and the full displayed window must fit recorded segments. Finite eligible-source native coverage is required in both channels, including interpolation bracketing frames. Stored NaN warm-up frames are not filled. No interpolation across acquisition pauses. Trial exposure differs across DMDs, but matches between signals within each DMD. C: separately selected positive-joint (both MI>0.1) and active Q2-nonsignificant examples: DMD2:9, DMD1:35. No amplitude gate. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not necessarily visually unresponsive. Context trial heatmaps; context green/control grey means ± trial SEM. F: all eligible context sources grouped by DMD1 then DMD2, with labels and a divider. Within each DMD retain the relative order from the frozen context-glutamate Rastermap fit, shared with calcium; no refitting or trace normalization. Context/control curves: solid positive-joint (both MI>0.1) sources, dotted Q2-nonsignificant sources, each classified independently per channel. Means equally weight sources; SEM is across sources, not mice or independent neurons. Sources may belong to the same dendrite/cell. All displays subtract each trial's full native preceding-grey mean. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon Q1 compares native 500-ms oddball and preceding-standard means; unpaired two-sided Mann-Whitney Q2 compares context/control response minus preceding grey. Exploratory raw p<0.05 and |MI|>0.1; solid/example responsive rule: positive-joint (both MI>0.1). Signed MIs are not clipped. BH alternatives use all 134 original sources per event/channel. No glutamate event detection, spike conversion or smoothing kernel. Linear 200-Hz alignment is display-only; tests use original native frames. Tan/grey shading shows actual median preceding-standard/oddball presentation bounds {'comparison': [-0.7000000001862645, -0.35700000018618994], 'response': [0.0, 0.3430000000000746]}, not the 500-ms test windows. X-limits -0.75 to +0.75 s. I: verified standard glutamate subset, 2 sessions/2 mice, November 18 828408 and December 11 829704. DMD1 and DMD2 Q1/Q2/Both proportions include either MI sign; no amplitude gate. Include session/groups with >=20 eligible sources before testability. Denominator: eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable source/session observations, not unique independent neurons. Heights pool counts, not session percentage means. Circle/square points show mice 828408/829704, respectively. No bootstrap confidence intervals for two mice. Six frozen-QC sessions contain other protocols, twelve legacy sessions have unresolved standard block/event mapping, and four newer standard sessions lack frozen labels; none are silently called nonresponsive. Native trial coverage matches the existing dual-channel reference definition; red frames are consulted for completeness only, not glutamate statistics. DMD1: 110 jointly testable/110 eligible; Q1 29, Q2 19, Both 10. DMD2: 85 jointly testable/85 eligible; Q1 18, Q2 10, Both 4. Heatmap limits: C ±4, F ±1; rounded 99th absolute percentiles, blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar. Population curves include 7 positive-joint and 95 Q2-nonsignificant sources. The composite adds vertical Single Unit/All Units row labels and one shared population color gradient with separate D/E/F native-unit limits. The original source columns have no individual colorbars.

svg.data-cohort-selection: 90-degree exploratory Q1 and baseline-subtracted Q2: p <0.05 and abs(MI) >0.1; Both is their intersection, including opposite-sign responses
svg.data-cohort-uncertainty: 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap; resample contributing mice with replacement within each region and recompute summed responsive / summed joint-testable counts; fixed session/group inclusion and shared resamples for Q1, Q2 and Both
svg.data-population-mean-filter: 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1
svg.data-nonq2-mean-filter: visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p and MI, p >=0.05; no example-only MI or firing-rate threshold; inherited QC-passing SUA firingRateHz >1
svg.data-heatmap-normalization: context SDF minus unit's own clean-context baseline mean (Hz); no SD normalization

B: identical positive-joint and Q2-nonsignificant example ROIs across both versions, VISl_6:64, VISp_1:52; context trial heatmaps and context (green)/control (grey, 50% opacity) means with across-trial SEM. This amplitude gate applies only to panel B, not population classifications. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not absence of visual responsiveness. E: context population heatmap in the same frozen context-dF/F Rastermap order for both signals. Population means and across-neuron SEM: solid positive Q1/Q2 responders (225 ROIs), dotted Q2-nonsignificant (1002 ROIs), classified separately per signal. All displayed values subtract each trial's native preceding-grey baseline. Statistical windows use native-frame means, not display interpolation: paired Q1 oddball versus preceding standard over equal 500-ms windows; Q2 Mann-Whitney on context/control response minus full preceding-grey baseline. Exploratory p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1; solid means additionally require both MI>0.1. Signed MIs are not clipped. No firing-rate eligibility gate, spike conversion, or Neuropixels smoothing kernel. Linear alignment at approximately 9.48 Hz is display-only. Tan/grey shading shows actual preceding-standard/oddball presentation windows (median trial-aligned bounds, approximately 367 ms), not the 500-ms statistical windows. X-limits remain -0.75 to +0.75 s. Units: ΔF/F change (%); native stored values without additional scaling. Heatmaps blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar; rounded 99th absolute percentile limits: B ±2, E ±0.4; larger values saturate. These response-selected curves are descriptive; SEM is not across mice. H: 90-degree cohort across 20 sessions in 10 mice. Pool planes within session/area; include groups with at least 20 eligible somatic High/Intermediate-SNR ROIs, before checking testability. Q1/Q2/Both bars include either MI sign and use this signal's own eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable denominator; n labels are ROI/session observations, not unique longitudinal neurons. Heights are pooled counts, not means of session/mouse percentages. Uncapped lines show exact 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap bounds (10,000 resamples, seed 0): resample whole mice carrying every retained session, then recompute pooled ratios. H has no amplitude gate. VISp: 15719 jointly testable / 15719 eligible ROI/session observations, 20 contributing sessions, 10 mice; Q1 5517, Q2 4066, Both 2633. svg.desc: SLAP2 glutamate: stored green iGluSnFR4f dFF series, native a.u., without additional scaling. C/F: mouse 828408, November 18 2025, one standard-oddball session. 134 original sources; 119 eligible (DMD1 79, DMD2 40), pooled across DMDs. Both signals use the identical frozen archive-wide glutamate High/Intermediate-SNR selection, not calcium-specific SNR. Fifteen no-baseline-noise sources excluded. Protocol-clean 90-degree trials: 30 context/68 control. Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials: DMD1 28 context/59 control; DMD2 28 context/38 control. Acquisition segments split at gaps >3 median native frame intervals; each statistical window and the full displayed window must fit recorded segments. Finite eligible-source native coverage is required in both channels, including interpolation bracketing frames. Stored NaN warm-up frames are not filled. No interpolation across acquisition pauses. Trial exposure differs across DMDs, but matches between signals within each DMD. C: separately selected positive-joint (both MI>0.1) and active Q2-nonsignificant examples: DMD2:9, DMD1:35. No amplitude gate. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not necessarily visually unresponsive. Context trial heatmaps; context green/control grey means ± trial SEM. F: all eligible context sources grouped by DMD1 then DMD2, with labels and a divider. Within each DMD retain the relative order from the frozen context-glutamate Rastermap fit, shared with calcium; no refitting or trace normalization. Context/control curves: solid positive-joint (both MI>0.1) sources, dotted Q2-nonsignificant sources, each classified independently per channel. Means equally weight sources; SEM is across sources, not mice or independent neurons. Sources may belong to the same dendrite/cell. All displays subtract each trial's full native preceding-grey mean. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon Q1 compares native 500-ms oddball and preceding-standard means; unpaired two-sided Mann-Whitney Q2 compares context/control response minus preceding grey. Exploratory raw p<0.05 and |MI|>0.1; solid/example responsive rule: positive-joint (both MI>0.1). Signed MIs are not clipped. BH alternatives use all 134 original sources per event/channel. No glutamate event detection, spike conversion or smoothing kernel. Linear 200-Hz alignment is display-only; tests use original native frames. Tan/grey shading shows actual median preceding-standard/oddball presentation bounds {'comparison': [-0.7000000001862645, -0.35700000018618994], 'response': [0.0, 0.3430000000000746]}, not the 500-ms test windows. X-limits -0.75 to +0.75 s. I: verified standard glutamate subset, 2 sessions/2 mice, November 18 828408 and December 11 829704. DMD1 and DMD2 Q1/Q2/Both proportions include either MI sign; no amplitude gate. Include session/groups with >=20 eligible sources before testability. Denominator: eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable source/session observations, not unique independent neurons. Heights pool counts, not session percentage means. Circle/square points show mice 828408/829704, respectively. No bootstrap confidence intervals for two mice. Six frozen-QC sessions contain other protocols, twelve legacy sessions have unresolved standard block/event mapping, and four newer standard sessions lack frozen labels; none are silently called nonresponsive. Native trial coverage matches the existing dual-channel reference definition; red frames are consulted for completeness only, not glutamate statistics. DMD1: 110 jointly testable/110 eligible; Q1 29, Q2 19, Both 10. DMD2: 85 jointly testable/85 eligible; Q1 18, Q2 10, Both 4. Heatmap limits: C ±4, F ±1; rounded 99th absolute percentiles, blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar. Population curves include 7 positive-joint and 95 Q2-nonsignificant sources.
